scheme_name: Reimbursement of Tuition Fee and Transport Facility to Scheduled Castes Students Studying in Technical Institutions in Haryana
other_conditions: Admission must be through centralized counselling.
Student should not be residing in a campus hostel to be eligible for transport facility reimbursement.
benefits_summary: Tuition fee reimbursement up to ₹20,000 for diploma courses or ₹40,000 for degree courses, plus reimbursement of actual state transport costs.
